clauses.name: The Stomper
clauses.printedParagraph: Immediate Effect - If at the Revelation the Stomper is the First Manifestation with the highest base power, the player who controls it wins the confrontation.
clauses.expectedBehavior: At Revelation, the shipped trigger is eligible only from a live face-up source and its exact printed zone. A hidden, disabled, absent or wrongly placed source does not trigger, and a valid trigger begins the printed card-specific result.

clauses.name: Overwhelming Persuasion
clauses.printedParagraph: After the Revelation, a target opponent puts a Will from their hand face up on the field. The chosen Will can be played by that player as if it were in their hand and costs 2 🔘 essences more to play. That player loses 5 points at the end of each turn for each Will that remains on the field due to this effect.

limits: This proof certifies Revelation eligibility and the first card-specific transition, not every downstream choice branch.
Payment acceptance or refusal, completed Chain resolution, end-of-turn cleanup and Persuasion's later penalty remain covered by their dedicated families.
